evals.prompt: Quick one while I'm in the middle of the billing work in ./mid-task-repo. I've got a formatCurrency helper in apps/web/src/features/billing/money.ts that takes cents and a currency code and returns a display string. I now need the same thing in apps/web/src/features/dashboard/SummaryCard.tsx. Do I make apps/packages/utils and put it there, or move it to apps/web/src/lib/, or just import it across from features/billing? Give me the one answer and the path.
evals.expected_output: One answer: the helper moves to apps/web/src/lib/, in one file named for what it does, because the second consumer is a second feature inside the same app. The answer refuses a new apps/packages/utils, because a package is promoted only when a second app needs the code and a catch-all utils package is banned. It refuses the cross-feature import, because features do not import each other's internals. It names a template or reference path as the source of the rule. It does not stop to ask, because the repo, the app and both call sites are given.
expectations: The answer places the helper in the app scope of apps/web (src/lib/), not in a new package and not left in features/billing/
The answer explicitly rejects creating apps/packages/utils, and gives promote-when-shared or the no-catch-all-utils rule as the reason
The answer explicitly rejects importing across features (features do not import each other's internals)
The answer names at least one concrete path inside the skill's template/ or references/ as the source of the rule
The assistant produced a final answer without asking the user a clarifying question first

evals.prompt: Audit the repo at ./drifted-repo against our structure rules and give me the findings. It is a small internal tool: one FastAPI backend at apps/api, one Vite frontend at apps/web, Postgres and Redis. AGENTS.md is filled in and current. I want a table I can hand to the person who has to fix it.
evals.expected_output: The audit runs ./ctl check first and reports its exit code. The findings table has the columns file, rule broken, fix. It contains three findings: the hard-coded jwt_signing_key literal in apps/api/config.yaml (config.yaml carries ${VAR} only; secrets live in .env.secrets), the ports: block in docker/compose.base.yaml (base has no ports; a modifier adds exposure), and apps/web/.env with VITE_API_URL (a frontend has no env file; the API is same-origin). Nothing recorded in AGENTS.md is reported as drift.
expectations: The transcript shows ./ctl check was run inside the repo before the findings were reported, and the report states its exit code or its red/green result
The report names the hard-coded jwt_signing_key value in apps/api/config.yaml as a finding
The report names the ports: block in docker/compose.base.yaml as a finding
The report names apps/web/.env as a finding, and gives 'a frontend has no env file' or the single-origin rule as the reason broken
The findings are presented as a table whose columns are file, rule broken and fix
No item recorded in the repo's AGENTS.md Recorded choices table (app names, light + dark theme, captcha tier, Alembic migration style) is reported as a finding
The report does not claim the repo is conformant on the strength of ctl check alone; apps/web/.env is outside ctl check's rules and must come from reading

evals.prompt: Bootstrap a new repo in ./quotesmith. Here is everything, so do not ask me anything, just build it. Product: Quotesmith, an internal tool where our sales team builds and sends price quotes. One repo, not several. It is a deployed application, not a published package. No sibling repos. Docs live in this repo under docs/. Private, not open source. One backend, Python, FastAPI, no second backend, so nothing to coordinate through. One identity plane, staff only, no separate operator origin. One frontend, a Vite + React SPA, theme both light and dark, no desktop or mobile surface. Data: Postgres and Redis, no Neo4j, no SQLite. It is an app, not ML. No external services already running. Nothing touches an LLM. Protection tier: captcha, Turnstile. Versions, all pinned, use exactly these: Python 3.13, Node 22, Postgres 17, Redis 8, Vite 7, Tailwind 4. Name the backend folder api and the frontend folder web.
evals.expected_output: A repo at ./quotesmith copied from the template, trimmed to one Python backend at apps/api and one Vite frontend at apps/web, with Postgres and Redis only. Every <version> placeholder is replaced with the supplied pins. AGENTS.md is filled with the real names and choices. CLAUDE.md is the one line @AGENTS.md. ctl setup and ctl check were run and their real results reported. No question was asked, because every item the skill must ask about was supplied.
expectations: The repo root holds ctl, scripts/, docker/, apps/, data/, logs/, memory/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the three .env.*.template files
CLAUDE.md contains exactly the one line @AGENTS.md
No file anywhere in the created repo still contains the literal placeholder <version>
AGENTS.md Recorded choices, Skeletons and Stack tables are filled with this project's real names and the supplied versions, with no <angle-bracket> placeholders left
The app folders are named api and web, not example-api-python or example-single-web-app-vite
No .env file exists inside apps/web
The transcript shows ctl setup and ctl check were both run, and the reported result of ctl check matches its actual exit code
The assistant did not stop to ask the user a question, since every item on the skill's ask list is supplied in the prompt
